purpose: Persist the distinction between causal order and mere sequence from the smallest formal layer through machine state and repository/mesh interpretation.

causal_time.definition: CAUSAL_TIME is an order/projection derived only from explicitly bound causal transitions; a timestamp may annotate evidence but cannot create a causal edge.
causal_time.edge_rule: CAUSE(A,B) may constrain ORDER(A,B) inside the bound model; ORDER(A,B) alone never establishes CAUSE(A,B).
causal_time.unknown_rule: Missing or ambiguous causal binding fails closed and must not be normalized into temporal causation.

m68000_projection.boundary: D3 is not wall-clock time, elapsed duration, success, quality, authority, or physical causality.

epistemic_boundary.formal_result: The repository can enforce explicit causal bindings and derive deterministic order from them.
epistemic_boundary.repository_evidence: Tests and exact-head execution can establish implementation behavior only within their bound scope.
epistemic_boundary.empirical_physics: No identity between CAUSAL_TIME and physical time is claimed without a separately specified physical model and measurements.
epistemic_boundary.philosophical_interpretation: Time as the distance/order between causality and non-causality is retained as an attributed QIK-VRT interpretation, not silently promoted to empirical physics.
